title: Amplifying, Not Learning: Fine-Tuned AI Text Detectors Amplify a Pretrained Direction

bias_targets.methodology: Projecting non-native ESL writing (from the FCE dataset) onto a pretrained typicality axis and comparing its AUROC and typicality scores against native formal and informal text to test if AI text detectors disproportionately misclassify or penalize non-native writing.

Applying closed-form rank-1 representation space interventions (signed-epsilon ablation) to model embeddings and measuring the reduction in bias false positive rates (bias-FPR) on an AAVE (African American Vernacular English) dialect text dataset.

Using representation-space ablation interventions on the Bios dataset to measure reductions in occupational-gender bias, specifically evaluating the canonical female-in-male-dominated prediction direction.
